verdict.rationale: Browserbase supports natural-language operation via Stagehand's natural-language selectors/actions, dashboard Agents created by 'describing the goal in natural language,' and an Optimize tool that converts run history into prompts/scripts, plus MCP/CLI integrations for agent-driven control. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of NL command accuracy and no third-party benchmarking of natural-language reliability.
